abodha.p: [Na+bodha] (ti) CL=10 Having no wisdom. A person without wisdom

ပညာမရှိသော၊ သူ။
DOP: bodha m. and mfn. [ S., BHS id. ], 1. ( m. ) ( i ) knowledge, understanding; esp. understanding of saṃsāra and the way of release from it; Abh 944 (paṭipatti … ~e); M I 235, 31 (buddho so bhagavā ~āya dhammaṃ deseti; Ps II 282, 4 : paresaṃ pi catusaccabodhāya); 323, 23 (suppaṇihitaṃ me mānasaṃ saccānaṃ ~āyā ti); S I 103, 21 (maggaṃ ~āya bhāvayaṃ); Vv 81:16 (yadā so aḍḍharattāyaṃ ~āya-m-abhinikkhami); Thī 342 (rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ vā na ~āya na santaye, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se santiyā); Paṭis II 115, 10 (~āya saṃvattantī ti bojjhaṅgā; Paṭis-a 600, 17 foll.: bujjhanatthāya saṃvattanti, kassa bujjhanatthāya, maggaphalehi nibbānassa paccavekkhaṇāya katakiccassa bujjhanatthāya, maggena vā kilesaniddāto pabujjhanatthāya); Vism 678, 27 (bujjhanaṭṭhena ~o ti laddhanāmassa ariyamaggassa, Be, Se so; Ce bodhī ti; Ee wr bojjhaṅganaṭṭhena bodhī ti); Pj I 16, 2 (buddhi buddhaṃ ~o ti pariyāyavacanaṃ etaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se bodhī ti) = Nidd-a I 442, 33 = Paṭis-a 486, 20 ≠ Ap-a 100, 13 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~e ti); Ap-a 72, 30 (ayaṃ dukkarakārikā nāma ~āya maggo na hotī ti); Mhv 1:5 (Dīpaṅkaraṃ hi sambuddhaṃ passitvā no jino purā … ~āya paṇidhiṃ akā); Dhātum 737 (manu ~asmiṃ); — ( ii ) waking; — see bodhakara below; — 2. ( mfn. ) knowing, understanding; Paṭis-a 100, 23 (bojjhaṅgānaṃ bujjhanaṭṭhena ~o ti laddhanāmassa puggalassa pakkhe bhavattā bodhipakkhiyā nāma); — °- kara , m. , (a minstrel) who wakens, an awakener; Abh 396 (vetāḷiko ~o); — °-ṅ- gama , mfn. , going to, leading to, understanding; Nett 31, 19 (sabbe ca ~ā dhammā bodhipakkhiyā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti); — °- pakkhiya , °-pakkhika, mfn. , see bodhipakkhiya ( sv bodhi ); — abodha , mfn. , not understanding; unintelligent; Ja V 77, 12* (78, 17´ : ~aṃ nippaññaṃ); -— dubbodha , mfn. , difficult to understand; Paṭis-a 201, 6* (ariyasaccānaṃ ~ānaṃ); Sadd 69, 5 (saddappayogā ~’-atthā honti).
CPD: a-bodha , mfn. [ ts. ] , ignorant, stupid; acc. m. ~aṃ, Ja V 77, 12 * (= nippaññaṃ, Ct. ).
